messages:
matt: heads up — we need to decide where to do payload coercion for v3->v4 migration. sticking it in gateway vs. a per-tenant shim? Thoughts?

sana: my vote is gateway for simple coercions (null->empty array, short->string) — fewer moving parts. But gateway can't do heavy fixes w/o latency.

jess: +1 but gateway changes are global. we'd need tenant opt-in flag. also testing surface is different.

matt: right. two options I've sketched:
- Gateway cheap coercions inline (fast, global, easy to rollback)
- Per-tenant shim that can do deeper normalization & retries (slower, per-tenant)

kai: question: what counts as "cheap"? type coercion, missing fields defaulting, small shape changes.

sana: exactly. anything requiring schema introspection or model-aware logic belongs in shim.

jess: also consider telemetry — we need per-tenant counts of coerced responses and failure rates. gateway can emit a header X-RW-Coerced:1 but we want metrics too.

matt: proposal: gateway handles micro-coerce (null->[] etc) + emits header
shim handles structural rewrites, with last-resort fallback to model-variant when shim fails.
Rollout: gateway rule enabled for all; shim deploy per-tenant opt-in.

sana: how to opt-in? tenant flag + header handshake? maybe use /v3/accept-coercions header to signal client readiness.

kai: we should avoid client headers as feature toggle. prefer tenant config in control plane and an X-RW-Coercion-Mode sent upstream.

jess: Also add a circuit breaker: if coercion rate > 1% and error spike then auto-disable for tenant and page owner.

matt: draft config:
```
coercion:
  mode: gateway | shim
  gateway:
    enabled: true
    max_payload_size_kb: 16
    emit_header: true
  shim:
    enabled: false
    tenant_opt_in: false
    circuit_breaker_threshold: 0.01
```

kai: love the circuit breaker. add observability: histogram of coercion_latency_ms, tags: tenant_id, route.

sana: testing checklist:
- unit tests for each coercion rule
- e2e tests with sample tenant mappings
- load test gateway path to measure p50/p95 impact
- rollback plan

matt: rollout timeline suggestion:
1) feature branch + canary in staging
2) enable gateway mode globally but default emit_header=false
3) enable header for a subset of customers + metrics
4) enable shim opt-in for early adopters
5) full enable with CBs, alerts, docs

jess: docs + migration guide required. also define deprecation window for old shapes.

sana: ok, I'll prepare RFC follow-up with config and telemetry hooks. @matt can you own the gateway PR?

matt: yep, i'll open PR tomorrow. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: canary/gateway-coercion v1 -> staging at 2026-03-22T05:12Z

matt: noted. keep the thread updated.
